content.title: Find First Missing Positive
content.description: Given an unsorted integer array nums, return the smallest missing positive integer. You must implement an algorithm that runs in O(n) time and uses constant extra space.

examples.explanation: The numbers in the range [1,2] are all in the array.
1 is in the array but 2 is missing.
The smallest positive integer 1 is missing.

hints: I think we can use a hash set to track numbers
That works but uses extra space. Can you think of a way to do it in-place using index placement?
Think about using the array itself as a hash table by placing each number at its corresponding index
The key insight is that for an array of length n, the answer must be in the range [1, n+1]
edge_cases: Array with all numbers greater than array length
Array already containing consecutive positive integers
follow_up_questions: What if you were allowed to use O(n) extra space?
How would you find the first k missing positive integers?
What if the array could contain very large numbers?
